Improve music artwork, add optional video comments, and integrate playback with Windows media controls.

- Music library song covers and the music player now request higher-resolution artwork rather than enlarging small thumbnails. Fall back to other available image sizes when the preferred artwork is unavailable.
- Add a persistent **Show video comments** switch in the Watch page and Application settings, disabled by default. Comments load only when enabled, with author details, timestamps, likes, pinned indicators, pagination and retry.
- Expose track titles, artists, cover artwork, playback state and position to Windows through Chromium's Media Session integration, including play/pause, seek and previous/next controls. The system media session follows the track actually playing across tabs instead of a paused track in the active tab. Register LokTube's Windows application identity to support system playback recognition and third-party flyouts such as FluentFlyouts.
- Retain the separate Shorts history and page/picture-in-picture persistence changes from 1.1.4 and earlier releases.

TypeScript checks, 31 core tests and desktop integration tests passed on the release candidate. Windows and Linux production builds and installer packaging completed successfully in GitHub Actions. Direct recognition and controls in FluentFlyouts still need verification on a Windows installation; live YouTube comments and available artwork sizes depend on each video and account.

Windows x64 and Linux x64 (AppImage/DEB) installers include the corresponding source archive and automatic-update metadata. Windows installers remain unsigned.
